question: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder is 3432 cm² and its height is 10.5 cm. The volume (in cm³) of the cylinder is (Take π = (22)/(7)):
solution:
Given:

The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder is 3432 cm2 and its height is 10.5 cm.

Concept used:

Volume of a cylinder = πR²H

Curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πRh

where R = Radius of the base, h = height

Calculation:

The radius of the base of the right-circular cylinder = 3432 ÷ (2π × 10.5)

⇒ 52 cm

Now, the volume of the cylinder = π × 52² × 10.5

⇒ 89232 cm³

∴ The volume of the cylinder is 89232 cm**³**.
